resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts calls the Oregon Department of Forestry site Windy Point. firelookout.com and the register call the Washington County Oregon Dept. of Forestry site Woods Point. The two may be one site, but the sources do not confirm it.

firelookout.com prints the elevation as 974' (with a foot mark); the register gives 3,196 ft (974 m). The 974 matches the register's metres, so firelookout's figure is probably metres written with a foot mark, not feet.

notes_for_editor: Record point (45.48567, -123.41345, from west_us_lookouts) is about 9 km south and 2 km east of the register's Woods Point coordinates (45.567850, -123.436620). Not changed here: identity of the two names is unconfirmed. If they are one site, the record point should move to the register's. Both registers call it a camp, so the kind may be camp, not a tower. Kemnow's 1N-6W-15 was not checked against the coordinates. No access, staffing or visit information found. Not used: willhiteweb.com's Windy Point Lookout Camp, which is in King County, Washington.
